articles.headline: India scraps import duties on some mobile-phone and electronics parts
articles.summary: India removed 7.5% and 5% import duties on some parts used to make mobile phones and other electronic devices. The change can lower input costs and improve supply-chain economics for manufacturers such as Apple and Xiaomi, with knock-on effects for vendors and assemblers operating in India.

articles.headline: Datadog earnings offer a cleaner signal on enterprise AI infrastructure demand
articles.summary: Datadog’s earnings were framed as one of the clearest indicators of whether enterprise AI infrastructure spending is translating into actual usage rather than just capex announcements. That makes it relevant for CIOs and finance leaders assessing cloud monitoring budgets, AI adoption, and software spend discipline.

articles.headline: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% as AI cost pressure intensifies
articles.summary: OpenAI sharply reduced pricing for one of its GPT-5.6 models, signaling that enterprise AI buyers are becoming highly sensitive to token costs. For businesses, this could lower inference spend and accelerate adoption of AI tools, while also increasing pricing pressure across the model market.
